# Plan: Create Kling Video Generator Skill

## Overview

Create a new Claude Code skill for Kling AI video generation with start/end frame support using Model O1, then test it with the provided breakfast images.

## Test Images

- **Start Frame**: Breakfast ingredients layout (blueberries 75g, egg, banana, rice flour 40g, cottage cheese 50g) with Ukrainian labels
- **End Frame**: Finished cottage cheese pancakes (syrniki) topped with blueberries and banana slices on ceramic plate

## Research Summary

### Kling O1 Model (from [official docs](https://app.klingai.com/global/quickstart/klingai-video-o1-user-guide))

- Model O1 is "the world's first unified multimodal video model"
- Key capabilities:
  - One engine for end-to-end video creation
  - Simple conversational prompts to control complex inputs
  - Stable subject construction across complex scenes
  - Supports 720p & 1080p with first-frame & last-frame control

### Kling API Details

- **Base URL**: `https://api.klingai.com`
- **Authentication**: JWT token (HS256) with:
  - `iss`: KLING_ACCESS_KEY
  - `exp`: current_time + 1800 seconds
  - `nbf`: current_time - 5 seconds
  - Signed with KLING_SECRET_KEY
- **Endpoint**: POST `/v1/videos/image2video`
- **Start/End Frame**: `image` (start frame) + `image_tail` (end frame)
- **Model Names**: Available models include `kling-v2-1`, `kling-v2-6`, `video-o1-image-to-video`
- **Duration**: 5 or 10 seconds
- **Flow**: Submit task -> Get task_id -> Poll for completion -> Get video URL

### Existing Skill Pattern (image-generator-nano-banana-pro)

- Structure: `SKILL.md` + `generate_image.py` + `.env` + `pyproject.toml`
- Uses `uv run` for execution
- Loads env from `.env` file in skill directory
- Argparse for CLI options

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Create Skill Directory

```
.claude/skills/kling-video-generator/
├── SKILL.md
├── generate_video.py
├── .env (symlink or copy from root .env)
└── pyproject.toml
```

### Step 2: Create `pyproject.toml`

```toml
[project]
name = "kling-video-generator"
version = "1.0.0"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = [
    "pyjwt>=2.8.0",
    "requests>=2.31.0",
    "python-dotenv>=1.0.0",
]
```

### Step 3: Create `generate_video.py`

**JWT Token Generation:**
```python
import jwt
import time

def generate_jwt_token(access_key: str, secret_key: str) -> str:
    now = int(time.time())
    payload = {
        "iss": access_key,
        "exp": now + 1800,  # 30 minutes
        "nbf": now - 5,     # Valid 5 seconds ago
    }
    return jwt.encode(payload, secret_key, algorithm="HS256")
```

**Core functionality:**
1. Load credentials from .env (KLING_ACCESS_KEY, KLING_SECRET_KEY)
2. Generate JWT token for authentication
3. Encode local images to base64 (or use URLs)
4. POST to `https://api.klingai.com/v1/videos/image2video` with:
   - `model_name`: `kling-v2-1` (or O1 model name to be verified)
   - `image`: Start frame (base64)
   - `image_tail`: End frame (base64)
   - `prompt`: Description of the transition
   - `duration`: 5 or 10 seconds
   - `mode`: `std` or `pro`
5. Poll task status until completion
6. Download video to output directory

**CLI interface:**
```bash
uv run --directory . python generate_video.py \
  --start-image ./start.png \
  --end-image ./end.png \
  --prompt "Smooth transition" \
  --duration 5 \
  --output ./generated_videos
```

### Step 4: Create `SKILL.md`

```yaml
---
name: kling-video-generator
description: |
  Generates AI videos using Kling Video O1 API with first-frame and last-frame control.
  Creates smooth transitions between two images. Use when user asks to create videos,
  generate video transitions, animate between images, or create recipe transformation videos.
---
```

### Step 5: Test Video Generation

Save the two provided images and run:
```bash
cd .claude/skills/kling-video-generator
uv run --directory . python generate_video.py \
  --start-image /path/to/ingredients.png \
  --end-image /path/to/pancakes.png \
  --prompt "Transform breakfast ingredients into delicious cottage cheese pancakes with blueberries and banana" \
  --duration 5 \
  --output ./test_output
```

## Files to Create

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `.claude/skills/kling-video-generator/SKILL.md` | Skill definition and documentation |
| `.claude/skills/kling-video-generator/generate_video.py` | Main Python script (~150 lines) |
| `.claude/skills/kling-video-generator/pyproject.toml` | UV dependencies |
| `.claude/skills/kling-video-generator/.env` | Credentials (KLING_ACCESS_KEY, KLING_SECRET_KEY) |

## Test Image Locations

Images need to be saved from this conversation to disk before running the test:
- **Start frame**: Ingredients layout image
- **End frame**: Finished pancakes image

## Implementation Notes

1. **Model selection**: Start with `kling-v2-1`, add `--model` flag for alternatives
2. **Error handling**: Include retry logic for transient API errors
3. **Progress feedback**: Print status during polling
4. **Video download**: Save with timestamp filename to output directory

- [Kling O1 User Guide](https://app.klingai.com/global/quickstart/klingai-video-o1-user-guide)
- [KlingDemo GitHub](https://github.com/betasecond/KlingDemo)

```bash

uv run python generate_video.py \
  --start-image /path/to/exploded_image.jpeg \
  --end-image /path/to/overhead_image.jpeg \
  --prompt "PROMPT" \
  --duration 5 \
  --output /path/to/output
```

### Image Paths
- **Start frame (exploded)**: `public/recipe_images/{category}_{n}.jpeg`
- **End frame (overhead)**: `public/recipe_images/overhead/{category}_{n}.jpeg`
- **Output**: `public/recipe_images/videos/{category}_{n}.mp4`

### Prompt Template
```
A high-angle, cinematic studio shot of a [DISH_DESCRIPTION] transforming into an exploded-view
visualization where individual ingredients gently separate and float upward in a vertical stack.
Smooth, dreamlike motion with soft studio lighting. Clean white background.
Professional food photography style with subtle depth of field.
```

### Step 1: Launch 8 Parallel Subagents

Each agent handles a batch of videos:

| Agent | Category | Range | Count |
|-------|----------|-------|-------|

| 2 | breakfast | 15-20 | 6 |
| 3 | desserts | 4-10 | 7 |

| 7 | lunch_dinner | 18-22 | 5 |
| 8 | lunch_dinner | 23-25 | 3 |

### Step 2: Each Agent Will

1. Read recipe data from `data/recipes.json` to get dish titles
2. For each recipe in its batch:
   - Generate video using Kling API
   - Rename output file to `{category}_{n}.mp4`
   - Move to `public/recipe_images/videos/`

### Step 3: After All Agents Complete

1. Verify all 40 videos were generated
2. Commit the new videos to git

## Key Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `.claude/skills/kling-video-generator/generate_video.py` | Video generation script |
| `data/recipes.json` | Recipe titles for prompts |
| `public/recipe_images/*.jpeg` | Exploded images (start frames) |
| `public/recipe_images/overhead/*.jpeg` | Overhead images (end frames) |
| `public/recipe_images/videos/*.mp4` | Output videos |

## Notes

- Model: `kling-v2-5-turbo` (default, supports image_tail)
- Duration: 5 seconds
- Mode: `pro` (auto-set when using end frame)
- Timeout: ~600s per video (API processing time)
